GC1.note: under the add-arm convention every column is standardized, the scores included: ridge's penalty on the full rotation is alpha sum_k lambda_k c_k^2 = alpha gamma' R gamma in the block's standardized coordinates, not isotropic, so ridge C1 is not a rotation of C2 (no gate); the rotation itself is gated on the variant with unstandardized scores (penalty alpha ||c||^2) against ridge on [BASE, the day's active block columns] at every day's first bar, where the two windows coincide

G2.note: direct: the window materialized, the map from scratch (SVD PCA, NIPALS PLS, the entry rule from scratch; C1 with the walk's eigenvectors, since ridge / lasso / elastic net on standardized scores are not invariant to rotations inside nearly tied eigenspaces), the weights recomputed from the materialized windows (ridge: the bar's; lasso / elastic net: the seed window's, the scores' at the later of the day's first bar and the seed), the walk's masks, pool_linear_pretune.fit_std (ridge_keep / batch_z: the batch homotopy, KKT-certified)
